name: cal_acc05_moving_to_creep_thd
comment: ACC_05-path moving->creep speed threshold (u16=973=7.60 km/h at 1/128), 80141528:176. Hysteresis partner of 0x800435e2. ACC_05 equivalent of 8013ef46 cal 0x800439fa. See RESULTS UPDATE 66 Q3-followup.

name: cal_cruise_torque_rate_falling
comment: Cruise/ACC engine-torque FALLING rate limit (clutch-open / torque release), 80141904 slope limiter. s16=20 (~40 Nm/s if res 2). Cand C_TQ_GRD_CLU_OPEN (MEDIUM conf). See UPDATE 62.

name: cal_cruise_torque_rate_rising
comment: Cruise/ACC engine-torque RISING rate limit (clutch-close / brake->drive re-engagement smoothness), in 80141904 asymmetric slope limiter on Ramd0007d06. s16=10 (~20 Nm/s if res 2). Lower=smoother/slower torque pickup. NOT indexed by ACC_Dynamik (fixed). Cand C_TQ_GRD_NORM_CLU_CLOSE (MEDIUM conf). See UPDATE 62.

name: cal_creep_to_moving_thd
comment: Creep->moving speed threshold (u16=1004=7.84 km/h at 1/128), 8013ef46:755 sets uRamc0001118 bit0x40. Hysteresis partner of 0x800439fa (973=7.60). Closes the engine<->ESP brake loop (TSK_02 out / ESP_05 in). Dispatched from 80108cc4 handle 0x600, gated by coding d000a753. ~20 exact bit-matches vs opendbc ESP_05 + FR TCS5. name: canrx_poll_dispatch_acc_esp

name: acc_epb_standstill_hold_statemachine

Hold timer d0001325->uRamc0001062->a54d(hold-confirmed >= cal 80043828[5]); a54b(drive-off inhibit); a54c(EPB fault-inhibit, 16 conds masked by cal 80043ccc[0x14]). name: canrx_ACC_01_DCC1_109
comment: RX decoder for DCC_1 / ACC_01 (CAN id 0x109), MLB E2E seed 0x08 (=(0x01^0x09); validates XOR-all-8==8 + rolling counter byte1 low-nibble). On E2E-OK writes acc01_ACC_Sollbeschleunigung(d0007bac=(b4&7)<<8|b3), acc01_ACC_Anhalten(a7ae=(b7>>1)&1), acc01_ACC_Dynamik(b06a=(b7>>2)&3). name: canrx_ACC_05_DCC5_10D

Writes acc05_ACC_Momentenanforderung(d0007baa=min(b0d4*raw*16,0x7fff) from 16|10 torque req), acc05_ACC_Freigabe_Momentenanf(a3b9=bit12), acc05_ACC_limitierte_Anfahrdyn(a3bd=bit15), acc05_ACC_StartStopp_Info(b056=44|2), acc05_ACC_Betaetigung_EPB(a3ba=bit60), ACC_Status_ACC(b057=57|3). Dispatched from 80108cc4 handle 0x8a0. Gateway_D4C7 msg, likely dormant on B8. 6 exact bit-matches vs opendbc ACC_05 + FR DCC_5. See RESULTS UPDATE 65.

name: acc_brake_request_formation
comment: ACC brake decel-request formation (CRUC_MG005): processes CAN 0x8a0 accel d0007baa via Kennfeld/Kennlinie lookups (line 249 lookup_kennfeld 0xa005b5e8/0xa0059890/0xa005abc0) + min/clamp cal chain -> writes Ramd0007c9a (line 419). The -3.0 decel limit lives in these decel-limit Kennfelds (0x7237 cells). See RESULTS UPDATE 57.

name: acc_dynamik_torque_switch_INERT

INERT: all 4 selectable cals = 500 (0x80043a96/aa2/aa4) so ACC_Dynamik has ZERO effect on this calibration. FR NORM/FAST/SLOW/TOUT gradients folded out (not live). See RESULTS UPDATE 62.

name: acc_brake_setpoint_statemachine

name: acc_driveoff_torque_momentenanf

ACC_05 stop-and-go DRIVE-OFF branch (:58-136, gated a757!=0 && a5a8!=0): fires when b057(ACC_Status_ACC) in {3,4} && a3b9(Freigabe_Momentenanf) && a54b==0(not inhibited) && b055==1(valid) && d0007baa>=cal 80043a5c[0x56]; maps d0007baa(Momentenanforderung)->d0007ce0 via kennlinie 0xa005d608 w/ rate-limit+hysteresis. Outputs Ramd0006998 (a5ac-gated) + b2a0. Present but cal-gated OFF on Q5. See RESULTS UPDATE 66.

name: esp05_ESP_Bremsdruck

name: tsk02_TSK_Freig_Verzoeg_Anf_src

name: tsk02_TSK_Anhalten_src
comment: TSK_Anhalten source, packed into TSK_02 (0x10C) byte2 bit4 by 80137a00:49/94. = acc01_ACC_Anhalten(a7ae) when b28e in {1,5} & a757(LV_DCC_ENA)!=0, else 0 (8013ef46:937-943). The engine's standstill-hold request to ESP. See RESULTS UPDATE 63/64.

name: tsk02_TSK_Zwangszusch_ESP_src
comment: TSK_Zwangszusch_ESP (forced ESP coupling/intervention ENABLE) source, TSK_02 (0x10C) byte7 bit6. Set 8013ef46:963-969 = (b28f in {1,2}). Live companion enable during active ACC control; NOT an independent hold. See RESULTS UPDATE 64.

name: acc_mode_ACC05_Momentenanf_sel
comment: ACC mode select = DAT_80043caf & 1 (sole writer 801abf64:21; cal-fixed). 0 (Q5, this image caf=0x06) = ACC_01 + TSK_02(80137a00, has Anhalten) + hold-relay branch enabled in 8013ef46:850 (requires a5a8==0). 1 = ACC_05 Momentenanforderung drive-off path (80141528) + TSK_05(80137f2c) + hold-relay DISABLED. Mutually exclusive with the ACC_01 hold relay. See RESULTS UPDATE 66.

name: acc_driveoff_active
comment: ACC drive-off-active flag (80141528:148): true if b28e in {1,2,5,6} OR the ACC_05 Momentenanf gate. When set, Ramd0006998 carries the drive-off torque; else 0x80000000 (neutral). See RESULTS UPDATE 66.

name: acc05_creep_status_tsk
comment: ACC_05-path creep/low-speed status (80141528:187), from ego-speed vs cals 0x800435e2/e6. Read by TSK packers 8011101c/80137d0c/80137f2c. A status bit, NOT a hard speed floor. (a5ad sibling is dead - no readers.) See RESULTS UPDATE 66 Q3-followup.

name: coding_GRA_ena
comment: GRA (basic cruise) coding enable, long-coding cell 27 type1 (decoded 801b5900). See RESULTS UPDATE 60.

name: LV_DCC_ENA

name: coding_F2S_bit_DEAD

name: tsk02_TSK_Codierung_ACC_src

name: acc_master_compute_enable

name: acc05_Momentenanf_valid
